notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Leaderboards are here![/b] And are currently a WIP, in other words, what score you set probably won't be sticking around forever (just yet) - once the bugs are ironed out and the stages are set in stone, leaderboards will be permanent. But, they begin nonetheless!

[h1]Some recent changes:[/h1]

[b]Added[/b] - block ability!
[b]Recreated[/b] - health bars for the player characters
[b]Changed[/b] - menu look
[b]Fixed[/b] - checkpoint bug
[b]Added[/b] - gore on hogs
[b]Added[/b] - video quality settings for potato - epic PCs
[b]Added[/b] - stats counter
[b]Fixed[/b] - Ben Shabibo activating too early
[b]Added[/b] - leaderboard for game time (more leaderboards to come)
[b]Added[/b] - cinematic quick skip function
[b]Fixed[/b] - some inputs that weren't mapped correctly
[b]Changed[/b] - rotation behavior of Brogan Homestead's music selection
[b]Fixed[/b]  - maybe kavkav UI not being displayed on entry
[b]Added[/b] - game timer that tracks your time from start to finish

Also:

Some combat volume QoL changes
Lots of under the hood refactoring of the level logic
Hogs now hold weapons correctly
Refactored game instance code
Timer now is cancelled when player permadeaths mid game

Thanks for playing and hope you're enjoying meme-ing it up!

notes.title: Added a Level Selector!
notes.notes:
This update includes a level selector that allows you to replay levels if you've completed them.

[list]
[*] [i]Fixed[/i] - combat music multiplying on triller level after death
[*] [i]Added[/i] - level selector 
[/list]

notes.title: Some minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed - Menu [i]should[/i] now be displayed after the credits 
Fixed - Combat volume wasn't triggering the UI on KavKav stage
